tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// dgra rkun jag pa la sogs la gsar rnying mang po nas bcud bsdus te dgra chings 'khor lo bzhugs so//

na mo padmā ka ra ya/ dgra dang jag pa la sogs dogs pa tsha ba'i sa char/ sgar pa gshar dgos pa'am rang gi brang nga rdzes pa sogs la dgra jag gis nyen pa'i sa yin na dgos pa gal che/ gsar rnying mang po nas bcud bsdus dgra chings kyi 'khor lo chu rlung sogs la bskor ba/ lag 'khor yang rung ste mkhar drung ba sogs kyis dgra chings lag 'khor byed pa'i phyir ro// de las dang po gro shog gang rung la 'khor lo mu khyud rim pa gsum du bskor ba'am/ phyi mu khyud dra sa dang drub sa yin/ de yi nang gi mu khyud la sngags ring thams cad bri/ de'i nang gi mu khyud la liṅga gnas yig bcas spyi ltar las sa lta'i sngags mgo phyi dang*/ gnam lta'i sngags mgo nang du dod par bya/ sngags mgo dbus nas sngags mjug phyi la thon par bya/ gnyis ka'i liṅga'i lte bar dza kha sprod/ kha sprod kyi bar du nṛ yig bri/ de yi rgyab nas/ oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mā ri tsyai māṃ swā hā/ dgra jag chom rkun thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnod par byed pa'i dgra jag chom rkun thams cad bla sha re ma ti 'grim 'grim sha ma ru ti thul thul myog myog yeng yeng sha ma ru ti khug ling myog ling sha ling thuṃ tsa mun tri dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bris liṅga'i phyi nas/ oṃ ya ma king kaṃ kha truṃ nṛ myog dgra bo jag rkun thams cad wā ka st+wambha ya nan/ bighnān tri thun ti shan ti shan spur thuṃ spur brub bi sha tsakra ha la ha la sa ma ya dgra bo jag rkun thams cad st+wambha ya yakṣa nan/ druṃ druṃ laṃ laṃ st+wambha ya nan/ oṃ kha thun kha thun sa ma ya dun tri/ pra le dzwa la pra le dzwa la gnod par byed pa'i dgra jag chom rkun thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan chings shig /ces bri'o// de ni king kang sngags ring ste 'dra min mang yang mkhar drung ba'i spar ma las bshus pa yin pas dag par yod/ ༈ de nas sa lta la dur khrod bdag po 'di bri'o// oṃ sha laṅka sha laṅka dur dur hab sha hab sha rgyug cig

/rgyug nas sod rgyug nas sod/ skyug cig skyug cig /skyug nas sod skyug nas sod/ du na dur dha rmug dha rmug dha ye swā hā/ dgra bo jag pa rkun ma thams cad kyi kha chings shig mchu sdoms shig /ces bri 'o// de ni dbang phyug sha laṅka'i sngags te dregs pa'i gzhung chen sogs nas byung ba'i dgra rkun gcan gzan btsan po rnams kyi kha chings yin/ gter kha mang po nas byung ngo*// sa lta'i liṅga'i phyi/ oṃ mā ri tsyai swā hā/ oṃ battā li ba dā li bā rā ha mu khī sarba duṣṭāṃ pra duṣṭāṃ tsakṣuḥmu khaṃ bhandha bhandha mu khi dzambha ya/ st+wambha ya/ mo ha ya swā hā/ lha mo 'od zer can ma'i las tshogs sngags ring 'di rtogs pa las byung ba'i nyams myong dang bcas pa yin/ de'ang mthud pa/ oṃ ka sha ka sha brag thal bral thal/ snying la chod chod/ ya ya tse tsi/ nan rbad rbad/ kha la raksha rbad/ snying la raksha rbad/ rus la raksha rbad/ rtsa la raksha rbad/ sha la raksha rbad/ khrag la raksha rbad/ gzugs phung la raksha rbad/ dran rig la raksha rbad/ dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum chings shig /st+wambha ya nan/ dgra bo jag rkun mā ra ya rengs rmug myog 'thib 'thib/ nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi dgra jag chom rkun thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan chings shig /'di ni bya mang brtson 'grus grags pa la rje btsun sgrol mas dngos su gnang ba'i rkun chings ra ru ma'i sngags yin/ gnam lta'i sha laṅka'i gong du/ dur khrod bdag po'i sngags 'di bris kyang legs pas/ oṃ ghri rā dza bhri rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this ma hā thar ni dgra jag chom rkun thams cad bhandha bhandha chings shig swā hā/ zhes bri/ gnyis ka'i phyi nang mu khyud gcig bskor bas/ hā swāḥṇa ma shra hā ma dī bā baṃ e ces rten 'brel log pa oṃ bar bri/ oṃ mu ne tsau ra murka tso tso swā hā/ jag pa chom rkun dza la mardha ye khug cig swā hā/ zhes 'dod gsol bcas pa bri/

dmigs bsal du yod tshe 'dir ming bri chog go /liṅga la rams kyis byug /liṅga lte bar lha dbye'i rdzas dang smyo khrag /sems can mgo 'khor shi ba'i sha khrag byug /thams cad thang phrom 'bru dang btsan dug sngo tsha ba gsum gyis byug go /dang po 'khor lor king kang gi 'gugs gzhug dang*/ lha dbye rtags thon bya/ 'khor lo'i sngags rnams rab gnas kyi tshul du thun rdzas sngags la brab nas/ tshon skud sogs kyis btsem/ gri lcags sam shing spam nag gis srog shing byas la chu rlung sogs la bskor ba'o// lag 'khor du byed rung ngo*// da dung zhal shes 'ga' re dang lag len mthong brgyud las kyang shes dgos pa yod do// zhes pa 'di'ang gnyer pa chos 'phel gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ sngags 'chang a rā gas bris pa'i dge bas chos byed sgrub pa rnams dgra rkun las rgyal bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// zhal shes 'ga' re yod zer ba ni/ lag 'khor byed na nṛ yig nas srog thur 'khor sbud lang thad rtse dgos/ thon na king kang ngam glang ru'i zhor sgrub dang*/ dur khrod bdag po'i gtor 'bul/ rnying ma spyi'i thun gtor dang dgra chos bsdus pa thon na legs/ bkra shis/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ gnam lta'i sngags 'khor ni/ dzanṛ oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ dgra bo jag rkun thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dgra rkun jag pa'i bla sha re ma ti 'grim 'grim sha ma ru ti thul thul myog myog ye ye sha ma ru ti khug ling myog ling sha ling thuṃ tsa mun tri dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ liṅga phyi mgo nas/ oṃ ya ma king kang kha truṃ nṛ myog dgra bo wāka st+wambha ya nan/ tri thun ti shan spur thun spur brub bi sha tsakra ha la ha la sa ma ya dgra bo jag rkun st+wambha ya rakṣa nan/ drun drun laṃ laṃ st+wambha ya nan/ oṃ kha thun kha thun ya ma ya ma dun tri dun tri pra le dzwa la pra le dzwa la dgra rkun jag gsum thams cad kyi kha chings shig

/oṃ mā ri tsyai māṃ swā hā/ badtā li ba dā li bā rā ha mu khī sarba duṣṭān pra duṣṭān tsakṣuḥmu khaṃ bhandha bhandha mu khaṃ dzaṃ bha ya st+waṃ bha ya mo ha ya swā hā/ dgra rkun jag gsum thams cad chings shig oṃ ka sha ka sha brag thal brag thal snying la chod chod ya ya tse tse nan nan kha la raksha rbad snying la raksha rbad rus la raksha rbad/ rtsa la raksha rbad sha khrag la raksha rbad gzugs phung la raksha rbad/ dran rig la raksha rbad dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum chings shig st+wambha ya nan dgra jag chom rkun mā ra ya rengs rmug 'thib 'thib nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi dgra bo jag rkun thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan chings shig /hā swā ṇa sogs rten 'brel log pa bri/ oṃ mu ne tsau ra mur rgya tse tse swā hā/ jag dza la ma dha ye khug swā hā/ nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo jag rkun thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum mā ra ya rbad nan chings shig kha chings shig mchu sdoms shig rkang lag chings shig ༈ / sa lta'i yig mgo phyir/ liṅga'i snying gar/ dzanṛ mgo nas/ oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ dgra bo jag rkun thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dgra rkun jag pa'i bla sha re ma ti sogs bla 'gugs sngags/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ liṅga phyi nas/ oṃ ya ma king kaṃ kha truṃ nṛ myog dgra bo wā ka st+wambha ya nan bighnān tri thun tāe tri shan tri shan sbur thun sbur brub bhi sha tsakra ha la ha la sa ma ya dgra sri rkun ma thams cad st+waṃ bha ya raksha nan/ oṃ truṃ truṃ laṃ laṃ st+wambha ya nan/ oṃ kha thun kha thun ya ma ya ma dun tri dun tri pra le dzwa la pra le dzwa la gnod byed dgra jag chom rkun thams cad mā ra ya nan chings shig /oṃ ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this ma hā thar ni dgra jag chom rkun thams cad bhandha bhandha swā hā/ oṃ sha laṅka sha laṅka dur hab sha hab sha dgra bo jag rkun thams cad kyi srog tsitta la sha ma ma 'gu 'gu shag shag rbad rbad rgyug cig rgyug cig rgyug nas sod rgyug nas sod/

rgyug cig rgyug cig rgyug nas sod rgyug nas sod/ du dha du dha mur dha mur dhe ye swā hā/ nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi dgra rkun jag gsum thams cad kha chings shig /spyang ki 'phar ba gsa' g.yi dom dred sogs gnod byed gcan gzan thams cad kyi rkang lag sdoms shig mchu chings shig / sa lta gnyis kyi phyi ma la/ hā swā ṇa ma bri/ oṃ mu ne rtso rtso mu rgya rtso rtso swā hā/ jag pa dza la ma dha ye khug swā hā/ nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas gnod par byed pa'i dgra jag chom rkun thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum mā ra ya rbad nan chings shig kha thuṃ mchu chings rkang lag chings shig / tshag med dang bskung yig med pa bri/ maṅga laṃ/// /
